mapper.select: SELECT id, approval_id, incident_code, action_command, proposed_by, approved_by, decision, created_at, decided_at FROM remediation_approvals WHERE incident_code = #{incidentCode} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO remediation_approvals (approval_id, incident_code, action_command, proposed_by, decision) VALUES (#{approvalId}, #{incidentCode}, #{actionCommand}, #{proposedBy}, #{decision})
mapper.update: UPDATE remediation_approvals SET approved_by = #{approvedBy}, decision = #{decision}, decided_at = NOW() WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, approval_id, incident_code, action_command, executed_by, execution_status, execution_output, executed_at FROM remediation_executions WHERE incident_code = #{incidentCode} ORDER BY executed_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO remediation_executions (approval_id, incident_code, action_command, executed_by, execution_status, execution_output) VALUES (#{approvalId}, #{incidentCode}, #{actionCommand}, #{executedBy}, #{executionStatus}, #{executionOutput})
